Subject: Request: Medaxa air-gapped deployment deep-dive (VPC/on‑prem requirements)

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the run-through last week. We're getting traction internally on a pilot and security wants a focused architecture deep-dive (VPC, on-prem footprint, import process for models/media, and audit/logging paths) before we sign off. Can your team run a 60–75 minute session next week to walk through:

- proposed network topology for an air-gapped install
- inbound/outbound requirements (if any) and all ports/protocols
- model import workflow and acceptable media formats for an air-gapped import
- KMS/HSM options and audit/log export paths
- expected uplift to latency/cost relative to hosted

Tentative attendees: Alex Taylor (security lead), procurement@medaxa.ai, and John Shepard (cloud ops consultant).

We are available:
- Tue 2026-11-24 10:00–12:00 PT
- Wed 2026-11-25 13:00–15:00 PT
- Fri 2026-11-27 09:00–11:00 PT

Also: could you share a short checklist of artifacts we should prepare on our side (network diagrams, firewall rules, compliance questionnaire)? I can circulate a calendar invite once we lock time.

Appreciate it — this is priority for our pilot.

—Alex
Alex Taylor
Security Lead, Medaxa
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>

Alex — thanks for the clear list. We can run a 60–75m technical deep-dive focused on exactly those bullets.

Availability from our side (Pacific):
- Tue 2026-11-24 09:30–11:00 PT (short overlap)
- Wed 2026-11-25 13:00–15:00 PT — prefer this slot
- Thu 2026-11-26 15:00–16:30 PT — backup

Proposed agenda (high level):
1) 10m: goals & success criteria (Medaxa)
2) 25m: network topology, egress policy, and firewall mapping (Vivek)
3) 15m: model import / media workflow + secure transfer options (Lauren)
4) 10m: KMS/HSM, audit logs, and retention
5) 10–15m: open q&a / next steps / roll plan

Attachments: I attached a short private-deploy checklist and a network zones template — please populate the template if you can, and send back the security questionnaire (we'll review beforehand).

One question: will your team require an on-site walkthrough (for removable-media import) or do you expect to rely on a courier-based image import? If you have any constraints on rack-level access or physical media policies please flag them now so we can tailor the call.

If Wed 11/25 works for you we'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link. I'll mark Vivek and Lauren to ensure the right folks are on the call.

Thanks — Priyom

- We'll populate the network_zones_template_v2.pdf and return it by Monday afternoon.

Thanks — I'll wait for the calendar invite.

Alex — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of operational notes ahead of Wed's session: 

- If you're shipping disk images, we'll want the checksum manifests and a documented import window. We'll cover the import tooling we recommend and what media formats we accept.
- For the network diagram: please include VLAN/subnet ranges and any existing NAT/transit gateways so we can validate S2S rules versus strictly air-gapped topologies.
- On pricing: I can speak to Dedicated vs Private packaging briefly; for detailed quotes I'll loop in our pricing lead afterwards.
- If possible, can you confirm whether Medaxa's HSM will be customer-managed on-prem or if you want Redwood to manage keys in a restricted partition? That choice impacts the key rotation and audit trail design.

If Wed 11/25 at 13:00 PT is confirmed, I'll block 90 minutes on my calendar as a buffer for any follow-ups.

Vivek
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
